name: Château-Thierry
summary: Pursuing Sacken and Yorck to the Marne, the Guard cavalry and Ney's infantry caught their rearguards before Château-Thierry and drove them over the river, but the bridge was burnt behind them.

sources.label: Six Days' Campaign order of battle (Wikipedia)

toCome.name: Mortier's Infantry
toCome.formation: Christiani's 2nd Old Guard and Meunier's 1st Young Guard Divisions
toCome.summary: Pressed the allied rearguard up the high road towards the Marne, Christiani's six Old Guard battalions attacking head on; two battalions of the Chasseurs à Pied and Guyot's duty squadrons fell on Katzler at Viffort.

toCome.name: The Guard Cavalry
toCome.formation: Colbert's, Lefebvre-Desnouettes's and Laferrière's Guard divisions, with Defrance's Gardes d'Honneur
toCome.summary: Laferrière's Guard dragoons and Defrance's Gardes d'Honneur rode at the Prussian columns, and Letort's squadrons broke Horn's brigade before the town and took its guns.

toCome.name: Yorck's Corps
toCome.formation: Katzler's advance guard, Horn's 7th Brigade and Jürgass's reserve cavalry, I Corps, Army of Silesia
toCome.summary: Covered Sacken's crossing of the Marne. Horn's brigade was broken before Château-Thierry, and two East Prussian battalions were cut off and taken.

toCome.name: Sacken's Corps
toCome.summary: Already beaten at Montmirail, it got back over the Marne at Château-Thierry; Heidenreich's brigade was overrun and mostly taken.
